description: Land Acquisition - Kosgahagoda, Agulmaduwa, Beligalla South and Wadiya and Kambussawela, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
